mapper.select: select distinct s.course_year as courseYear, s.term_name as termName, s.period_name as periodName, s.grade_name as gradeName, s.subject_name as subjectName, s.teacher_id as teacherId, coalesce(nullif(trim(u.user_name), ''), nullif(trim(u.nick_name), ''), s.teacher_name) as teacherName from edu_course_schedule s left join sys_user u on u.user_id=s.teacher_id where s.del_flag='0'
select count(distinct coalesce(e.student_id, a.student_id)) as studentCount, count(distinct case when coalesce(e.student_id, a.student_id) is null then e.enrollment_id end) as unidentifiedEnrollments

select distinct coalesce(e.student_id, a.student_id) as studentId, st.student_name as studentName
and coalesce(e.student_id, a.student_id) is not null order by studentName, studentId

select date_format(p.paid_time, '%Y-%m') as month, sum(p.amount) as contractAmount, sum(p.amount) - coalesce(sum(r.refund_amount), 0) as confirmedAmount, coalesce(sum(r.refund_amount), 0) as refundAmount from edu_tuition_payment p left join ( select rf.payment_id, sum(rf.approved_amount) as refund_amount from edu_tuition_refund rf where rf.refund_status = 'SUCCESS' group by rf.payment_id ) r on r.payment_id = p.payment_id where p.payment_status = 'SUCCESS' and p.paid_time is not null and date_format(p.paid_time, '%Y-%m') between #{begin} and #{end} group by month

select date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m') as month, sum(case when o.order_status <> 'CLOSED' then o.payable_amount else 0 end) as contractAmount, sum(case when o.pay_status = '1' then o.payable_amount - o.refunded_amount else 0 end) as confirmedAmount, sum(case when o.pay_status in ('1','2') then coalesce(o.refunded_amount,0) else 0 end) as refundAmount from edu_material_order o where o.del_flag = '0' and date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m') between #{begin} and #{end} group by month
select salary_month as month, sum(coalesce(total_amount, 0)) as salaryAmount from edu_teacher_salary_record where del_flag = '0' and salary_month between #{begin} and #{end} group by salary_month

select date_format(expense_date, '%Y-%m') as month, sum(amount) as expenseAmount from edu_finance_expense where del_flag = '0' and date_format(expense_date, '%Y-%m') between #{begin} and #{end} group by month
select expense_type as expenseType, sum(amount) as expenseAmount from edu_finance_expense where del_flag = '0' and date_format(expense_date, '%Y-%m') between #{begin} and #{end} group by expense_type
